review_method: Manual inspection of each marked task prompt, original assertions, reference source and proposed mutation sites; static typed-input predicates enforce the stated domains. No reference/candidate execution, candidate performance filtering, or automatic attestation of unseen tasks.
limitations: Reference-derived outputs are not semantic proof. Approval concerns only listed mutation IDs and pinned reference source.
Original source assertions and examples sometimes supply conventions absent from prose; these restricted interpretations are recorded per task.
Unreviewed tasks and newly introduced mutation IDs are excluded. Fewer than three approved mutations rejects the task.
Remote original-reference and codec/probe gates remain required; domain counts are not a guarantee of final accepted-case yield.
Length-preserving and alphabet-permuting probes can preserve outputs and provide limited additional coverage.
No final/test prompts or reference code were inspected; only native train/validation inventory was opened.
